title: Shut down screens 30 minutes before bed.
subtitle: Sleep guardrail
rationale: Remove the light and cognitive input that keep the nervous system online late.

evidence.summary: Pre-bed screen use can impair sleep through light exposure, alerting content, and displaced sleep time.

sources.label: Screen use and sleep consensus statement

indications: Screens are in hand at lights-out on most nights.
Sleep onset takes more than 20 minutes.
